versions.short: The bill would designate July 20 as Lunar Landing Day and encourage private citizens, organizations, and federal, state, and local governments to recognize it through proclamations, activities, and educational efforts that mark the first successful landing of humans on the Moon on July 20, 1969 and support continued United States leadership in space exploration and science. It would also renumber the sections of the federal code that list national observances and add Lunar Landing Day to that list.
